name: Major Sheepskin

intro.text: Operation Sheepskin, March 1969. A small, careful invasion by about three hundred paratroopers and a few London police, aimed at an island with no army.
We were greeted by a beach party. The newspapers called it the Bay of Piglets. The islanders call it a Tuesday.

win: A battle won, and nobody hurt. Just as we planned it in 1969.
after: They've since made me an honorary Anguillan. I've not been told what the hours are.
